home.metaTitle: Im Birkenhain — residential development in Rudolfstetten-Friedlisberg
home.metaDescription: Im Birkenhain: 278 rental apartments on the forest edge in Rudolfstetten-Friedlisberg. 17 building areas, car-free at ground level, natural pool, bistro, day-care and gym.
home.heroTitle: Generous, sustainable living on the edge of the forest
home.heroLead: On the Isleren site a quarter of 17 staggered houses is taking shape between the Mutschellen junction and the forest: 278 rental apartments, a square under birches, and not a single car above ground.
home.situationsplanHint: Select a building area to see its details.

architektur.metaDescription: 17 building areas of three to eight full storeys, stepped towards the forest edge. Beige Eternit façade, dark bronze and a stone plinth — materials and phasing at a glance.
architektur.title: 17 townhouses, stepped towards the forest
architektur.lead: The houses do not stand in a row but offset: each has its own address, each leaves its neighbour a view. From eight storeys on the north-west corner they step down towards the forest edge.
architektur.pendingData: Figure pending from the design plan.

freiraum.metaDescription: A path network like the roots of a tree, the birch grove as signature tree, a square with water feature, seating steps and bistro terrace. Landscape design deltavormgroep.
freiraum.title: The forest continues into the quarter
freiraum.lead: What lies between the houses is not leftover space but a continuous landscape: paths branch like roots, differences in level are taken up by planted walls, and at the centre stands the birch grove.

lage.metaDescription: On the edge of the Mutschellen junction: the S17 every 15 minutes, Zurich HB in 31 minutes, two stops within a ten-minute walk. Car-free above ground, garage at the entrance.
lage.title: Between the Mutschellen junction and the forest
lage.lead: Well connected and yet at the end of the road. Cars go underground right at the entrance to the site; above ground the quarter stays car-free — open only to deliveries, emergency vehicles and moving days.

nachhaltigkeit.metaDescription: A ground-source heat pump with 22,000 m of probes, 2,900 m2 of photovoltaics, battery storage, free cooling and on-site retention — the energy concept in detail.
nachhaltigkeit.title: Density where the infrastructure already is
nachhaltigkeit.lead: Instead of new building land at the edges, the quarter uses a key site inside the existing settlement, ten minutes from the railway. That is the most effective sustainability measure in the whole project.

wohnungen.metaDescription: 278 rental apartments from 2.5 to 5.5 rooms, designed for DINKs, families and best agers. Layouts and areas are provisional; rents and letting start follow later.
wohnungen.title: 278 rental apartments
wohnungen.lead: The apartments are designed for three kinds of resident: compact flats for DINKs, family flats of 3.5 to 5.5 rooms, and stepless flats for best agers. Layouts and areas are provisional; rents and the start of letting follow later.
wohnungen.spiegelPending: The apartment overview will be published as soon as the apartment data is available.

datenschutz.metaDescription: How the Im Birkenhain project website handles personal data: registration form, double opt-in, map, no cookies.
datenschutz.title: Privacy
datenschutz.reviewNote: Draft, written from the actual technical implementation. To be reviewed by legal counsel and completed with the controller's details before the site is released.
datenschutz.controllerBody: Real North AG as the client of the Im Birkenhain project.
datenschutz.controllerPending: To be added: address and an email address for data subjects to contact.
datenschutz.dataBody: Only what you enter in the registration form yourself: first name, last name and email address are required; phone number, preferred number of rooms, move-in date and notes are optional. No personal data is collected if you do not register.
datenschutz.purposeBody: The details are used solely to add you to the registration list and to contact you when letting begins. No profiling and no automated individual decision-making takes place.
datenschutz.consentBody: After submitting you receive an email with a confirmation link. Your registration is stored only once you click it. The link is valid for seven days and can be used once. If you do not confirm, the unconfirmed registration is deleted automatically and completely after seven days.
datenschutz.retentionBody: Confirmed registrations are kept until initial letting is complete and are deleted afterwards. You may request deletion at any time; registering again remains possible.
datenschutz.securityBody: The data is held on the hosting provider's web server in a file outside the publicly accessible area. Your email address is additionally stored as a check value (HMAC) so that duplicate registrations can be detected without keeping the address as a plaintext lookup key. The confirmation link does not contain your email address.
datenschutz.abuseBody: To prevent automated mass registrations, the number of attempts per IP address and per email address is counted for at most one hour. The IP address is used only as a counter, is not linked to your registration, and is deleted once the hour has passed.
datenschutz.processorsBody: No data is disclosed for advertising purposes and no data is sold. The hosting provider's mail server is used to send the confirmation email and acts as a processor in that respect.
datenschutz.processorsPending: To be added: name and domicile of the hosting provider.
datenschutz.mapBody: The map on «Location & mobility» loads map tiles from OpenStreetMap. It loads only after you explicitly click it — before that, no request reaches OpenStreetMap. Clicking transmits your IP address to OpenStreetMap. The consent is held only in your browser's session storage and ends when you close the tab.
datenschutz.cookiesBody: This website sets no cookies, uses no analytics or tracking tools and embeds no advertising networks. Fonts are served from our own domain, not by a third party. The web server logs access technically, as is usual with any web hosting.
datenschutz.cookiesPending: To be added: retention period of the hosting provider's server access logs.
datenschutz.rightsBody: You have the right to information about the data processed about you, to rectification, to erasure and to data portability. An email to the address above is sufficient. You may also contact the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
